description: Source code for the DataElementFile class managing memory-mapped file operations across Linux and Windows platforms, including file opening, closing, reallocation, and synchronization.

classes.name: DataElementFile
classes.description: Class handling memory-mapped file operations with platform-specific implementations for Linux and Windows.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the file and maps it into memory if not already open.

methods.name: OpenMemoryMappedFile
methods.description: Creates a memory-mapped view of the file with specified size, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Unmaps and closes the memory-mapped file handle.

methods.name: Reallocation
methods.description: Reallocates the memory-mapped file to a new size, handling remapping.

methods.name: Sync
methods.description: Flushes changes to disk if the file is shareable.
